name: journal_block
description: Injected into the proposer turn: the researcher's accumulated experience from PREVIOUS runs, read out of the persistent journal (harness/memory/). Distinct from prior_factors_block / negative_factors_block, which carry only what happened at earlier dates INSIDE the current walk-forward. Deduplicated by formula, so a mechanism that died repeatedly carries its own weight. Omitted when the journal is empty or config.memory is off.
template: RESEARCH JOURNAL --- what you have already learned across $n_runs previous
run(s) of this harness. This is your accumulated experience, not this run's
history. Use it: do not spend iterations re-deriving a mechanism the record
already shows is dead, and do not simply copy a past winner either --- the
universe, the window and the objective may differ. `xN` is how many times a
formula has landed the same way, and `#` stands in for a number that varied
